# RyxerMart — Full Agency & Package Specification

## Company Information
- Name: RyxerMart (RyxerMart Web Solutions)
- Website: https://www.ryxer.site
- Slogan: Build Your Business Online & Fast.
- Primary Focus: Affordable, enterprise-quality web design, dynamic e-commerce stores, and software solutions for Indian SMEs, startups, and service professionals.
- Location: Jalandhar, Punjab, India (Remote & nationwide delivery throughout India).

## Core Value Propositions
1. Fixed, 100% Transparent Pricing: No unexpected invoices or hidden maintenance fees.
2. Free 1-Year Cloud Hosting: High-speed SSD servers included with automatic SSL certificates.
3. Rapid 3–5 Day Delivery: Quick project turnaround from initial brief to live launch.
4. Direct WhatsApp Coordination: Fast, direct communication with developers without bureaucracy.
5. Mobile-First & Speed Optimized: Scores 90+ on Google PageSpeed Insights, built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.
6. Search Engine Ready: Pre-configured OpenGraph social previews, Schema.org rich snippets, and Google Search Console sitemaps.

### 4. Ecommerce Premium Package
- Price: ₹14,999 (Fixed one-time)
- Delivery Time: 7–10 business days

## Technical Architecture
- Framework: Next.js (App Router, Server Components)
- Language: TypeScript
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Database: PostgreSQL (Neon Serverless) with Prisma ORM
- Deployment: Vercel Edge Network
- Performance: Core Web Vitals optimized, responsive SVG/WebP graphics
